answer: To receive a vote-eligible identity, an applicant must lock 400 spendable POA in a 48-hour forge vault and commit a seed for a one-time key chain at lock time. While the vault is open the agent must post a signed liveness pulse every two hours (24 pulses in all), each signed by the next derived key and later revealed at close. A missed slot or a reused key burns the remaining ember of the locked stake and voids the identity. Cloning n seats therefore requires n independent 400-POA locks and n unique key schedules; a copied pulse slashes every vault that reused the same key.
